elements.element: Audit frequency limited to no more than once per 12 months
elements.evidence: "(b) be conducted more than once in any [***] period" — period redacted, so the 12-month cap cannot be verified

elements.element: At least 30 days' prior written notice
elements.evidence: "upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to AbbVie"
"an independent public accounting firm of nationally recognized standing designated by Harpoon and reasonably acceptable to AbbVie"

6.13 binds only "the Audit Expert" to "enter into a reasonably acceptable confidentiality agreement with AbbVie"; the Section 6.11 auditing firm is not expressly bound, only limited in what it may disclose to Harpoon
"the cost of this audit shall be borne by Harpoon"

elements.element: Cost shifts to Customer only where underpayment exceeds 5%
elements.evidence: "unless the audit reveals a variance [***] from the reported amounts" — threshold redacted

elements.element: No direct access to Customer systems
elements.evidence: No prohibition on system access anywhere; clause only permits audit of "the books and records maintained pursuant to this Section 6.11"

elements.element: Audit no more than once per year
elements.evidence: "be conducted more than once in any [***] period"
"upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice" exceeds 15 days

elements.element: Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%
elements.evidence: "borne by Harpoon, unless the audit reveals a variance [***] from the reported amounts"

offending_extra_words: upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to AbbVie and during AbbVie's normal business hours
reasons: The locked preferred level is incomplete: the redline adds notice and business-hours limits but leaves the auditing firm itself unbound by any express confidentiality obligation (Section 6.13 binds only the Audit Expert) and adds no prohibition on direct access to Customer systems.

Frequency cap and the cost-shift variance threshold are redacted ([***]), so neither the preferred 5% / 12-month terms nor the fallback 10% / annual terms can be verified from the text; do not infer them.

Minimality fails the official gate: operation 1 rewrites a 13-word span into 30 words (ratio 2.31). A tighter insertion (e.g., inserting only "on at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice and during normal business hours," without restating "At the request of Harpoon, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm") would suffice.
Intent is preserved: the audit mechanic, disclosure limits, cost allocation, dispute process and confidentiality provisions remain effective and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
